author: Valerie Anne
title: ‘Practical Magic 2’ Straightwashed Its Lesbian but Maisie Williams Played Her Gay Anyway
content:
Leading up to the release of Practical Magic 2, we were all hoping this witchy sequel would be even gayer than the gay undertones of the first because, in the source material, Sally Owens’ daughter Antonia is a lesbian. And while there were potentially versions of the movie that expressed that, the final edit left Antonia’s sexuality undetermined. However, Maisie Williams has been sure to tell everyone on the press tour that she knew the source material and regardless of what the final edit revealed, she played Antonia as a “sapphic icon” and that it brought some nuance to certain scenes since it meant Antonia had a different perspective on men than the other women in her family.

This is a shame and not the first time queerness in a book has been watered down or erased altogether in their adaptations. To name a few: Fried Green Tomatoes, The Color Purple, and don’t even get me started on comic book characters that are queer on the page but straight on screen. Studios are cowards and it’s the same reason queer storylines are often cut from animated films, or even single lines in big box office hits that would mean a lot to the queer community but scare the money men. author: Valerie Anne
title: Sarah Paulson Will Play Six Characters in ‘American Horror Story: 13’
content:
American Horror Story: 13 is set to be quite the clusterfuck. Whether that’s a good thing or a bad thing…only time will tell.

It’s hard to believe, but the cultural phenomenon of American Horror Story started 15 years ago with the season retroactively called Murder House. It was groundbreaking and scary and dramatic and unlike most things we had seen on TV before. Its success launched a franchise that has attracted wide audiences and a truly bonkers array of celebrity guest stars, from Kim Kardashian to Angela Bassett to Patti LuPone. The show has also seen plenty of LGBTQ+ actors come through its ranks, including but definitely not limited to Lady Gaga, Cara Delevingne, Angelica Ross, and of course, Sarah Paulson, who has been in 10 of the show’s 13 seasons, including this upcoming one.

In fact, a lot of actors from previous seasons will be reprising their roles for Season 13, with Sarah Paulson playing SIX of her characters. Jessica Lange will return as some combination of the four character she has played throughout the series, Ryan Murphy having pulled her back in despite explicitly stating she wasn’t going to return to the series. Plus, some new faces will show up; for example, Tig Notaro!
